name: driven transmon (Duffing image)
question: Does the strongly driven transmon (Duffing truncation) show a threshold write under its drive amplitude?
assumptions: H = omega_q b^dag b - (E_C/2) b^dag2 b^2 (Blais eq. 25) driven at detuning Delta, in units of the decay
valid only while the Duffing truncation holds (a few excitations); vacuum noise kappa/8
